brief: Cleaner large-facet alternate with wide logo-safe center; exploratory source only. V006 remains active until native 320x224 comparison and human review.
prompt_constraints: Only a few large angular crystal clusters at far left and right edges.
Central 62 percent remains very dark, smooth, empty, and logo-safe.
Compact bottom-center ignition with two or three deliberate radial lines.
Remove microtexture, tiny shards, dense crystal walls, haze, bloom, and repeated patterns.
No text, logo, particles, characters, interface, watermark, or copied IP.
translation_gate: Create 320x224 indexed 4bpp basic and curated comparisons on the Mega Drive 9-bit grid.
Review native silhouettes, central negative space, highlight footprint, and wordmark overlap.
Measure H/V tile counts and full selected-art residency separately from total runtime VRAM/DMA.
Keep outside /res unless the native result is superior and approved in later curation.
prompt: Create a refined alternate of this existing Mega Drive startup splash background concept. Preserve its 4:3 composition, deep navy/near-black center, cold blue crystal identity, and small lower-center ignition. Background plate only: remove text, logos, wordmarks, particles, and lettering. Simplify: only a few large readable angular crystal clusters at the far left and right edges, broad coherent facets, large silhouette breaks. Keep the central 62% very dark, smooth, empty and logo-safe. Keep the bottom-center ignition compact, with only two or three deliberate radial energy lines. Remove tiny shards, speckle, micro-texture, dense crystal forests, haze, gradients, bloom, and repeated checker patterns. Make the edge clusters asymmetric but visually balanced, with icy cyan highlights on only a few facet edges. Preserve strong hierarchy and a calm dark center. High-quality 16-bit console background concept with deliberate pixel-art-friendly shapes, not photorealistic. No typography or symbols.
